description: Checks every crates.io package in a Cargo.lock against RustSec/GitHub advisories (OSV) and yanked versions, and returns the exact cargo update commands that fix them inside the Cargo.toml requirements, plus what needs a manual bump. Needs an enterprise api_key (https://tensorust.com/offers/enterprise-api/).

api_key.description: Your Tensorust Data API key (tdk_...), enterprise key from https://tensorust.com/offers/enterprise-api/

name: audit_cargo_lock
title: Audit a Cargo.lock and get the fix (key)
